title: 我们的时光相册
footer: 一段冒险，一段故事，一段友情o(*￣▽￣*)ブ
script: <script>window.addEventListener('load', function() { var links = document.querySelectorAll('a'); links.forEach(function(link) { if(link.href && link.href.includes('.html')) { var isMainCard = link.querySelector('h3') || link.innerText.includes('photos'); if (isMainCard) { link.style.transition = 'all 0.4s ease'; link.style.borderRadius = '16px'; link.style.border = '3px solid transparent'; link.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { this.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px) scale(1.02)'; this.style.boxShadow = '0 15px 40px rgba(251, 114, 153, 0.3)'; this.style.borderColor = '#FB7299'; var img = this.querySelector('img'); if(img) img.style.transform = 'scale(1.08)'; }); link.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { this.style.transform = 'translateY(0) scale(1)'; this.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 20px rgba(251, 114, 153, 0.12)'; this.style.borderColor = 'transparent'; var img = this.querySelector('img'); if(img) img.style.transform = 'scale(1)'; }); } else { link.style.transition = 'all 0.4s ease'; link.style.borderRadius = '12px'; link.style.border = '3px solid transparent'; link.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { this.style.transform = 'translateY(-6px) scale(1.03)'; this.style.boxShadow = '0 10px 30px rgba(0, 161, 214, 0.3)'; this.style.borderColor = '#00A1D6'; var img = this.querySelector('img'); if(img) img.style.transform = 'scale(1.08)'; }); link.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { this.style.transform = 'translateY(0) scale(1)'; this.style.boxShadow = 'none'; this.style.borderColor = 'transparent'; var img = this.querySelector('img'); if(img) img.style.transform = 'scale(1)'; }); } } }); });</script>
